verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਦ ਅਛਤ ਅਮਤਰਗਤਿ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: man mirag mirag madh achhat amataragat bhoolio bhram khojat firat ban maahee jee ||

en.bdb: Human mind is like a fast running deer who has Naam-like musk within him. But under various doubts and misgivings, he keeps searching it in forest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਦਰ ਸਰੋਜ ਗਤਿ ਏਕੈ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhaadhar saroj gat ekai saravar bikhai a(n)tar dhisa(n)tar hui samajhat naahee jee ||

en.bdb: Frog and lotus flower live in the same pond but despite that the frog-like mind does not know lotus as if he is residing in a foreign land. The frog eats moss and not lotus flower. Such is the state of mind who is not aware of the Naam Amrit co-existing with it, and stays indulged in vices.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਧਰ ਤਜੈ ਨ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਖਮ ਕਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਵਨ ਬਿਰਖ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bikhiaa dhar tajai na bikh bikham kau ahinis baavan birakh lapaTaahee jee ||

en.bdb: As a snake never sheds his venom although he keeps coiled around a sandalwood tree so is the state of that person who does not shed his vices even in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਭਰਮ ਮਿਟਾਹੀ ਜੀ ॥੨੨੩॥
verses.translit_en: jaise narapat supana(n)tar bhekhaaree hoi gurmukh jagat mai bharam miTaahee jee ||223||

en.bdb: The state of our wandering mind is like a king who becomes a beggar in his dream. But the mind of a Sikh of the Guru dispels all his doubts and misgivings with the power of Naam Simran and recognising his self, lives a purposeful, contented and a happy life. (223)
